sdmx_status: ABS SDMX API (https://data.api.abs.gov.au/rest/v1) has no GFS/COFOG dataflow; the full ABS dataflow catalogue (1,228 dataflows) contains no GFS, COFOG or Government Finance dataflow and every plausible GFS dataflow id returns HTTP 404. No SDMX query is used.
notes: Official ABS GFS Annual 2024-25 Key Tables 9/10 "Expenses by purpose" (COFOG-A) XLSX. Units are $m confirmed from workbook row 7. Every row is an official aggregate: measure_type=actual, verified=true, data_quality_flag=verified, aggregation_role=benchmark. Levels are federal/state/local; jurisdiction is Australia or the state/territory code; no LGA/coordinates are invented. Total rows and the "All levels of government" columns are not ingested. Transport is stored as 045 and must not be rolled into 04. ABS GFS is a top-down statistical aggregate supplied by the ABS. It is a benchmark, not a sum of projects. Never add GFS rows to project data, and never sum across levels of government or across measure types. Bytes are archived outside the repo.
